message.content: {"note_claim":"The 13,000 figure is a cumulative count of non-citizens convicted of homicide on ICE’s non-detained docket as of mid-2024, rather than murders committed by illegal immigrants in 2024; some may be incarcerated.","label":"SUPPORTS","quote":"The DHS said: \"The data goes back decades; it includes individuals who entered the country over the past 40 years or more\"","reason":"The page directly says the data span decades, reports the July 2024 ICE docket figure, and explains that people not in ICE custody may be incarcerated elsewhere."}

parsed.note_claim: The 13,000 figure is a cumulative count of non-citizens convicted of homicide on ICE’s non-detained docket as of mid-2024, rather than murders committed by illegal immigrants in 2024; some may be incarcerated.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The DHS said: "The data goes back decades; it includes individuals who entered the country over the past 40 years or more"
parsed.reason: The page directly says the data span decades, reports the July 2024 ICE docket figure, and explains that people not in ICE custody may be incarcerated elsewhere.
